The business process for an automobile insurance claim consists of the following phases: "¢ Submission: The customer contacts a customer service representative (CSR) to file the claim. "¢ Review: An adjuster reviews the claim, assesses the damages to each vehicle, and provides an estimate of the cost of repairs. "¢ Repair: A third party performs the repairs on each vehicle, communicating with the adjuster and customer as necessary. "¢ Verification: After each vehicle repair, the adjuster closes the claim. According to Pega best practices, which phase can you implement as a child case? A. Submission B. Verification C. Review D. Repair
